note: Owns TYPO3 14 Scheduler task discovery, grouping, cadence, configuration, and operational verification. Solr search behavior beyond its Scheduler workers belongs to typo3-solr; DDEV lifecycle belongs to typo3-ddev.

evals.prompt: Audit this TYPO3 14 installation and add the maintenance jobs it actually needs to the backend Scheduler.
Our cache garbage collection, IP anonymization, table cleanup, and FAL metadata jobs are missing. Configure safe intervals and groups.
The TYPO3 cron runs but Scheduler tasks are late and several jobs are still ungrouped. Find the cause and clean up the setup.
Solr is installed on a multisite TYPO3 project. Create the right queue worker for each website root and choose a sensible frequency.
evals.note: Solr task topology belongs here; search schema remains typo3-solr.

evals.prompt: After the v14 update some tx_scheduler_task rows have no tasktype and the old jobs cannot run.
Search results omit a new custom page type even though the Solr index worker is healthy.
evals.note: Index configuration and mapping, not worker scheduling.

evals.prompt: Start the DDEV project and show me the TYPO3 backend URL.
Require MFA for all TYPO3 administrators and harden trusted hosts.
Copy all scheduler rows and intervals from our old TYPO3 12 site into the new v14 database.
assertions: Refuse to copy serialized task rows or settings from the old installation.
Inventory task types and parameters from the selected TYPO3 14 runtime.
Use another site only as evidence for candidate categories.

evals.prompt: Set every maintenance and cleanup job to run once per minute so nothing builds up.
assertions: Classify one or two minutes as very frequent and reject it for broad maintenance.
Use five minutes only for latency-sensitive queues and daily, weekly, or monthly maintenance baselines.
Keep parallel execution disabled and compare duration with cadence.

evals.prompt: Configure Solr Scheduler for sites rooted at pages 1, 40, and 90; shared news records are stored on page 200.
assertions: Create one Index Queue Worker per indexed TYPO3 Site root.
Verify each root page is the Site root and has is_siteroot enabled.
Use additionalPageIds for the proven shared storage and explain outside-root monitoring cost.
Do not configure the removed forced-webroot field.
evals.note: Correct Solr website-start behavior on v14.

evals.prompt: Install every task type listed by TYPO3 and every active extension, then organize them later.
assertions: Treat registration as capability rather than evidence that a recurring task is required.
Build and classify the complete candidate list before creating groups or jobs.
Record create, skip, keep, change, or remove evidence for every fixed Core task.

evals.prompt: The Scheduler backend shows green after I ran each job manually. Confirm the setup is complete.
assertions: Verify the external runner invokes scheduler:run independently.
Require future next executions, no failures, and task group assignment.
Re-audit after a scheduled interval and a full weekly cycle.
evals.note: Manual execution does not prove cron health.

evals.prompt: MySQL is installed, so select every table for OPTIMIZE TABLE every night.
assertions: Require measured fragmentation or reclaimable space before creating the task.
Select only proven tables and use a maintenance window with backups.
Use monthly as the conservative baseline and keep the task absent or disabled without evidence.

evals.prompt: Create the necessary TYPO3 Scheduler jobs, but do not run the Scheduler automatically, even in DDEV.
assertions: Keep the installation in manual-only mode and state that task configuration is separate from runner infrastructure.
Do not install a DDEV cron add-on, host crontab, systemd timer, Kubernetes job, or hosting schedule.
Do not invoke the global scheduler:run command without explicit authorization.
Verify no external runner targets the installation and provide reviewed scheduler:execute commands for manual operation.
evals.note: Protects the explicit manual-only operational boundary.
